task_instance: Set up a minimal Vite + React app that uses the AlphaTab music-notation library (@coderline/alphatab plus its Vite plugin) to render an AlphaTex drum-beat snippet and expose playback controls, then build/verify that the notation renders and the player initializes, as the skill's core deliverable describes.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable depends on the AlphaTab JavaScript library and its Vite plugin (the @coderline alphatab and alphatab-vite packages), which are not installed on this machine (node require.resolve returns MODULE_NOT_FOUND). Node 22, npm 10 and bun 1.4 are present, but obtaining these packages requires fetching them from the public npm package registry, i.e. network access, which this air-gapped offline runtime does not grant and which the safety rules forbid (no npm install, no network). Without the real library there is no way to render notation or run the audio player; the skill also requires bundled binary assets (the Bravura notation font and a sonivox soundfont) that are likewise not present locally. Per the run rules I did not write a stub/mock replacement for the missing library.
